summary.text: Terri Violet is a Republican state representative who has represented Missouri House of Representatives District 104 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. She served in the U.S. Navy and previously served as an alderman in St. Peters, Missouri.

paragraphs.text: Violet served in the U.S. Navy and previously served as an alderman in St. Peters, Missouri.
She won the 2024 general election for the District 104 seat over Tara Murray and took office on January 8, 2025.
For the 2025-2026 session, Violet was assigned to the Children and Families Committee and the Local Government Committee.
